claims.claim: The item is a wooden pallet-style bed frame / pallet base.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a rectangular pallet-style wooden frame with multiple slats and cross slats (Photos 0–2).

claims.claim: The seller’s words about pallets being used in logistics/warehousing.
claims.evidence: No photo evidence relates to the seller’s general statements; only the bed-frame appearance is shown.

risks.risk: Unknown overall dimensions and mattress fit (could be too small/large for common sizes).
risks.proof: A photo with a tape measure showing length and width of the frame, plus height from floor to top slat.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic pallet base with uncertain fit (worst-case: may not match standard mattress sizes).

risks.risk: Structural integrity issues (loose joints, broken slats, rot/worm holes) not clearly visible in the provided angles.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of all corners and underside joints, plus one photo showing any damaged/uneven slats; also a quick shake test video showing no wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing repair/with unknown condition (worst-case: treat as not fully reliable for heavy load).

risks.risk: Missing hardware/fasteners or incomplete assembly (bolts/straps not shown).
risks.proof: Photo of the full frame showing all connection points, and a separate photo of any included bolts/fasteners (or confirmation none are included).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as frame-only with no guarantee of included hardware (worst-case: buyer may need to source fasteners).

risks.risk: Surface finish and pest/termite treatment unknown (untreated wood can be a problem).
risks.proof: Photo of the wood surface close-up (grain/finish) and any treatment marks; plus a close-up of any worm holes if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untreated/unknown treatment (worst-case: buyer may need treatment before use).

risks.risk: No confirmation of included mattress/headboard/side rails; buyer may expect more than just the base.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full set of items included (or a clear statement with photos of what is present).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as pallet base only (worst-case: no mattress or accessories included).

proof_requests: Provide a photo with a tape measure showing the frame’s length and width, and the height from floor to top slat.
Send close-up photos/videos of all corners, underside joints, and every slat (including any cracks, loose parts, worm holes, or rot).
Show connection points and any included bolts/fasteners; confirm whether any parts are missing.
Show a close-up of the wood surface finish and any treatment (or confirm none).
Confirm what’s included in the sale (base only vs mattress/headboard/side rails).
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item type as a pallet-style wooden bed frame/base, so it can be priced at its worst-case as a generic pallet base with unknown dimensions and condition. Missing proof items affect the price only through worst-case assumptions, not identification.
